title: Waypoint::to_cbor skips validate() unlike WaypointShare::to_cbor
description: Pre-existing asymmetry surfaced by 1vy1 review passes (not introduced by it): WaypointShare::to_cbor (waypoint.rs:110) validates empty names, NaN/Inf, coordinate ranges before encoding, but Waypoint::to_cbor (waypoint.rs:395) encodes unvalidated onto the wire while its doc comment advertises POST /waypoints use. Align: validate in Waypoint::to_cbor too (or document why not), without breaking the byte-parity vectors.
